name: AtomStack Hurricane 55W
tagline: Desktop CO₂ cutter from Atomstack : 55W tube in a modern enclosed chassis
tldr: AtomStack Hurricane brings CO₂ cutting to Atomstack buyers who outgrew diodes. Cuts acrylic and wood thicker than any diode in this price class. Requires space, ventilation, and water cooling discipline : not apartment-friendly.
mainObjective: Desktop CO₂ for acrylic cutting and wood production beyond diode limits

primaryUse: Desktop CO₂ production for acrylic gifts, signage, and wood cutting.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack Hurricane is built for acrylic signage, thick wood, and shop production once exhaust is sorted. 55W adds headroom on panels and multi-pass jobs.
editorialDepth.limitations: Avoid without ducting, for occasional gifts only, or if budget ignores tube replacement, power, and floor space. Bare metal without an IR accessory stays out of scope.
